# siSwati (ss)

[Edit source](../../locales/ss.json)

Plural rule: `one_other` (categories: one, other)

## Needs review

These parts of the data are uncertain. If you speak the language, please check the
examples below against them and fix [ss.json](../../locales/ss.json),
deleting the note from its `review` list once the data is right.

- **`time.clock`** (low confidence): Nguni-style ordinal hours: 'lihora lesitsatfu' (the third hour) = 3 o'clock, 'lihora lekucala' = 1 o'clock, 'lihora lelishumi nakubili' = 12. Minutes: 'lihora {h} nemizuzu lelishumi' (class-4 concords: lemihlanu, lelishumi, lelishumi nesihlanu, lemashumi lamabili ...); half 'nenhafu' (as the file's duration data). Doubts: siSwati class-4/class-6 concord forms for the minute numerals are modelled on isiZulu and may be off; speakers often say 'hafu pasi' colloquially. Hours 9 in the old data ('sifisagcina') replaced with 'lemfica'. Needs native review.
